data.title: Pristine
data.about:
Pristine by Zoya Developments is an upcoming luxury residential project located in the thriving community of Al Furjan, Dubai. The apartments consist of six floors with two podium levels. Whether you are looking for a cozy one-bedroom or a spacious three-bedroom apartment with a private pool and garden, Pristine Zoya Properties is designed to cater to your every need.

The project features a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each meticulously designed to enhance comfort and luxury. With a focus on well-being and sustainability, Pristine incorporates vastu-oriented designs, energy-efficient features, and smart home technology to provide residents with a harmonious living experience.

characteristics_module.title: A  Collection of Luxury Residences Promoting Well-Being
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Reputable Developer: Built on Zoya's 14 years of experience and excellence in real estate development.
  • Premium Views: Apartments offering stunning views of the surrounding landscape.
  • Easy Payment Plan: Flexible 3-year post-handover plan, with only 1% monthly payment.
  • Vastu-Oriented Design: Homes designed according to Vastu principles, ensuring harmony and positive 
  • energy.Energy Efficient: Incorporates sustainable and energy-saving technologies.
  • Smart Tech Home Control: Equipped with advanced smart home systems for convenience and security.
  • Exceptional Rooftop Amenities: Residents can enjoy exclusive rooftop amenities, adding to the luxury lifestyle.

location_tile.title: Enjoy Prime Living in Al Furjan
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Pristine by Zoya Developments is ideally situated in Al Furjan, one of Dubai’s most sought-after residential communities. Known for its connectivity and vibrant environment, Al Furjan offers residents easy access to major highways, public transportation, and a range of lifestyle amenities. The strategic location ensures that everything you need is just a short drive away, making Pristine an ideal choice for families and professionals alike.

Al Furjan Metro Station - 4 Minutes
Ibn Battuta Mall - 10 Minutes
Dubai Marina - 14 Minutes
Palm Jumeirah - 20 Minutes
Al Maktoum International Airport - 23 Minutes
